## Interpretation
The calibrated catalogue-based result gives a very low annual probability of a Pohang-like Mw ≥ 5.5 event (≈1.2 × 10⁻⁴/yr at b = 1, rising to ≈1.5 × 10⁻²/yr at b = 0.65), with Sigma strongly negative (≈ −5.3 to −5.4) — no indication of injection-induced seismicity in the calibrated LBNL catalogue. The net-negative fluid balance (more extracted than injected) over the window is also consistent with no induced-seismicity signal.
